\label{ch:sliding_window}

\begin{tcolorbox}[enhanced, colback=white, colframe=secondaryblue, boxrule=1pt, arc=2mm]
\textbf{\large\textcolor{primaryblue}{A window that grows on the right and shrinks on the left: longest, shortest and counting questions about subarrays in one pass.}}
\end{tcolorbox}

\chapterfacts{1100}{1800}{5}{10}{30}

\begin{plannedbox}[Planned Contents --- this chapter is not written yet]
\textbf{Part A --- Lessons}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{A\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item Fixed-size windows: add the entering element, remove the leaving one
    \item Variable windows: the grow--shrink loop and the invariant "the window is valid"
    \item Longest valid window versus shortest valid window: where the answer is updated
    \item Counting windows: "at most $k$" minus "at most $k-1$", and counting all subarrays ending at $r$
    \item When the window breaks: negative numbers, non-monotone predicates, and the fallback to prefix sums (window extrema are the stack-queue-heap book)
\end{enumerate}
\textbf{Part B --- Patterns} (with the two solved problems of each pattern)
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{P\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item \textbf{Fixed-size windows} --- Maximum Average Subarray I {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 643)}, Maximum Points You Can Obtain from Cards {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1423)}
    \item \textbf{Longest valid window} --- Max Consecutive Ones III {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1004)}, Books {\small\color{darkgray}(CF 279B)}
    \item \textbf{Shortest valid window} --- Minimum Size Subarray Sum {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 209)}, Minimum Operations to Reduce X to Zero {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 1658)}
    \item \textbf{Counting windows} --- Subarray Product Less Than K {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 713)}, Subarrays with K Different Integers {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 992)}
    \item \textbf{Windows with a frequency table} --- Maximum Sum of Distinct Subarrays With Length K {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 2461)}, Count Subarrays Where Max Element Appears at Least K Times {\small\color{darkgray}(LeetCode 2962)}
\end{enumerate}
\end{plannedbox}
